macros.name: notomono
macros.doc:
Macros 
otoserif, 
otosans and 
otomono select the NotoSerif, NotoSans and NotoMono families, respectively, and 
otoseriflgr, 
otosanslgr and 
otomonolgr activate the LGR encoding.
